data.subject: finance back-office at Zipline
data.body:
Hi Sendil,

A few months into the CFO seat at Zipline, core accounting workflows usually get a hard look. With the Walmart agreement expanding across 300 additional sites, that tends to mean more site-level vendor contracts, purchase orders, and invoice approvals landing on the same team.

Coming from Tesla's finance org, you have seen what scale does to close and AP throughput. Instacart cut AP approval time from 2 weeks to 2 days. Worth a 20-minute call to see if Zamp's AI agents fit?

[Your name]
